In a new lengthy interview on Clique TV, Apple CEO John Ternus answered a series of questions covering topics including his vision for the future, how his family uses technology, the invitation to become CEO, and his thoughts on Vision Pro.

New CEO Takes Office: John Ternus's Long Interview Covers Wide Range of Topics

Mouloud Achour of Clique TV sat down with Apple's new CEO John Ternus for an interview earlier this month, which was just released over the weekend.

Ternus discussed a wide range of topics during the interview, including making a compelling case for Apple Vision Pro. As one of his first major interviews since taking over as CEO, he was naturally asked about the transition process.

On Being Invited to Become Apple's New CEO

Ternus was also asked about an important lesson he learned from his predecessors Tim Cook and Steve Jobs. When asked to share specific quotes from these two former Apple leaders that motivated him, Ternus gave a slightly different answer.

On His Vision for Apple's Future, Including Artificial Intelligence

On the Role of Technology in Children's Development
